auditor.name: auditor
auditor.official_description: name of the external audit firm.

business_segments_num.name: business_segments_num
business_segments_num.official_description: number of business segments reported. Enter a number.

cash_reserves.name: cash_reserves
cash_reserves.official_description: total cash and cash equivalents held at period-end. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate.

dividend_per_share.name: dividend_per_share
dividend_per_share.official_description: dividends paid per share for the period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate.

earnings_per_share.name: earnings_per_share
earnings_per_share.official_description: earnings per share (EPS) for the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate.

exchange_code.name: exchange_code
exchange_code.official_description: The code of the stock exchange where the company is listed (e.g., ASX, SUN).

major_equity_changes.name: major_equity_changes
major_equity_changes.official_description: whether there were major equity changes during the period; choose one from ['Yes', 'No'].

net_assets.name: net_assets
net_assets.official_description: net asset value at the end of the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate.

net_profit_or_loss.name: net_profit_or_loss
net_profit_or_loss.official_description: net profit or loss amount for the reporting period (enter a negative number for loss). Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate.

principal_activities.name: principal_activities
principal_activities.official_description: main business activities or industry classification; choose one or more from ['Mining', 'finance', 'Healthcare', 'Manufacturing', 'Technology', 'Retail', 'Energy', 'Utilities', 'Real Estate', 'Transportation', 'Agriculture', 'Telecommunications', 'Media', 'Other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. Mining || finance).

remuneration_policy.name: remuneration_policy
remuneration_policy.official_description: executive remuneration policy type; choose only one from ['Fixed', 'Performance-based', 'Stock Option', 'Mixed', 'Not Disclosed'].

revenue.name: revenue
revenue.official_description: total operating revenue recognized during the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate.

the_highest_ownership_stake.name: the_highest_ownership_stake
the_highest_ownership_stake.official_description: the highest percentage of ownership held by a single shareholder. Enter a number, unit: percent (%).

total_debt.name: total_debt
total_debt.official_description: total debt outstanding at the end of the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate.
